newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 22.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Lorry drivers step up protest for better wages and working conditions, blockade hits fuel delivery.
-- Matra Communication, a 50 percent subsidiary of Lagardere Groupe and Northern Telecom seeks a partner in GSM mobile telephone activity.
-- High-technology firms to hire some 1500 qualified workers in Southern France through a new selection process relying on skill tests rather than diplomas.
-- Lagardere Groupe chairman Jean-Luc Lagardere launches legal action in response to minority shareholders who criticised the terms of a 1990 Matra-Hachette merger.

-- National audit council criticises as unjustified fund transfers from state-owned atomic energy group Framatome to two of its shareholders, Alcatel and CEA Industries that may reach up to 573 million francs.
